title: How Far Could CRM Stock Swing In A Year?
summary: Salesforce (CRM) stock trades at about $236 after returning about 58% over three months. Its options now price a range over roughly a year that runs from about $152 to about $368. The bottom of that band is a price the stock has already traded through within the past year, and the market is pricing the band a little calmer than the stock has actually moved.

title: Is UiPath Stock Cheap Because Of What AI Might Do?
summary: UiPath (PATH) has fallen about 27% from its one-month high, though it is still up 34% over three months. The stock trades at 19.5 times earnings, against an S&P 500 median of 22.6. For a software company growing faster than most of the market, that looks like a gift. The question is whether investors see an AI threat the numbers do not show yet.

title: Salesforce vs. ServiceNow: Which Technology Stock Is a Better Buy in 2026?
summary: Salesforce offers a more attractive valuation and proven cash generation. ServiceNow offers faster growth and a more defensible market position.

title: The AI Software Story Wall Street Is Underrating
summary: Salesforce's agentic AI business is scaling at a pace that would make most enterprise software companies envious, yet the stock keeps getting priced like a relic from the CRM era. Something in that gap looks like an opportunity Wall Street has not yet caught up to.

title: Wall Street’s Palantir Price Targets Tell an Interesting Story
summary: Palantir has gone from ice cold to white hot in a matter of weeks, and Wall Street analysts cannot agree on what that rally is actually worth. The gap between the most bullish and most bearish targets reveals a fundamental disagreement about where this AI story goes from here.
